The '''6-B hover train''' was a [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] speeder train used for [[Hovertrain/Legends|mass-transit]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] pursued the criminal [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Cassie Cryar]] onto a train of this kind. As the vehicle traveled through [[electromagnetic tube]]s, the chase continued on top of the train, until Cryar smashed her way into the passenger compartments. She was eventually subdued at a train stop by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]].<ref name="LL" />
